description: Mynawoo helps authenticated learners start and continue a personal language-learning plan in ChatGPT. Learners can confirm their explanation language and course, take a private placement assessment or begin at A1, get chat lesson explanations, create private grammar practice completed in Mynawoo, and manage Leitner vocabulary plus coaching suggestions. Course-content access remains subject to the learner's Mynawoo plan.
